integrity: The two standalone independent complete integer enumeration paths and the general odd-degree covering proof are included; no external independent audit has been performed.
limitations: Exact classical twelve-site zero-temperature Potts result, not bulk thermodynamics. Historical priority remains provisional because unindexed finite graph tables or equivalent defective-coloring results may exist. Generic partition-function algorithms are prior art.
title: A sharp odd-valence coloring obstruction and the complete magnetic response of the icosahedral three-state Potts antiferromagnet
